hooks.name: pytest-on-agent-stop
hooks.description: When the agent stops, run the test suite from the repo root and append a timestamped execution record to .pytest_cache/stop-hook-runs.log.

action.command: bash -c 'R=/projects/sandbox/causelens; [ -x "$R/.venv/bin/python" ] || R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$R" || exit 0; mkdir -p .pytest_cache; LOG=.pytest_cache/stop-hook-runs.log; echo "=== stop hook start $(date -u +%FT%TZ) cwd=$PWD" >> "$LOG"; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q > .pytest_cache/stop-hook-last.txt 2>&1; RC=$?; tail -5 .pytest_cache/stop-hook-last.txt >> "$LOG"; echo "=== stop hook end $(date -u +%FT%TZ) pytest_exit=$RC" >> "$LOG"; tail -5 .pytest_cache/stop-hook-last.txt; exit 0'
